data.name: Hurra
data.gender_notes: Hurra is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'hur', which means 'free' or 'happy'. The name Hurra carries the meaning “Free, Happy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hurra usually hope their child will grow to embody free, happy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Hurra is a name given to both boys and girls, symbolizing freedom and happiness. It is also associated with the concept of 'Jannah', the Islamic paradise, where believers are promised eternal happiness and freedom from worldly constraints.
data.etymology: Hurra belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Free, Happy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hurra total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_urdu.name: حُرّہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: حُرّہ وہ خاتون ہے جو آزادی اور استقلال کی مالک ہے، اور وہ علم اور تقوا کی بلند مقام پر فائز ہے، یہ کلمہ عربي جڑ ح ر سے ماخوذ ہے، جو آزادی اور استقلال کو بیان کرتا ہے، اور اسلام میں اسے صالح خاتون کے لیے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے

in_pashto.name: حُرہ
